keys.swarm.aura_ember_orbit_desc: Embers circle close around you and burn any monster they touch.
keys.swarm.aura_ember_orbit_ten: Black Wheel of Fire: one solid ring of fire spins round you and burns all it touches.
keys.swarm.aura_spike_ring_desc: Rings of spikes ripple out from you along the ground, hitting each monster once as they pass.
keys.swarm.aura_spike_ring_ten: The Iron Garden: a spiked hedge stays up round you and roots anything that touches it.
